text: 非农爆表！美国8月新增就业16.2万人，预期仅5.5万人，失业率维持在4.1%不变。 美国8月就业数据超预期，市场加大对美联储9月加息的押注。 挪威石油基金或将其持有的美国国债减少约800亿美元。 媒体消息称，三星电子联合Arm研发下一代端侧AI芯片。 报道：铠侠计划以升级版NAND替代部分DRAM。 美光HBM产能年底前有望翻倍，追赶三星、SK海力士步伐。 报道：苹果折叠屏iPhone日产量仅“几百”台，开售初期或供应紧张。 韩国出兵霍尔木兹海峡？韩总统府：仍处于“研究审议”阶段。 日经225指数收涨1.3%，沪指收涨0.02%，恒指收跌0.39%。
text_en: Nonfarm payrolls shock! U.S. added 162,000 jobs in August, far above the expected 55,000, with unemployment holding at 4.1%. U.S. August employment data beat expectations, boosting market bets on a September Fed rate hike. Norway's oil fund may cut its U.S. Treasury holdings by about $80 billion. Media reports say Samsung Electronics is teaming up with Arm to develop next-generation on-device AI chips. Reports: Kioxia plans to replace some DRAM with upgraded NAND. Micron's HBM capacity could double by year-end, catching up with Samsung and SK Hynix. Reports: Apple's foldable iPhone daily output is only a 'few hundred' units, potentially tight supply at launch. South Korea to deploy troops to the Strait of Hormuz? Presidential office: still under 'review and consideration.' Nikkei 225 closed up 1.3%, Shanghai Composite up 0.02%, Hang Seng Index down 0.39%.
